name: void-harness
description: VoidCorp craftsman harness — universal core skills plus capability-first packs (monorepo, react, nextjs, server, pwa, mobile) for opinionated Claude Code projects.

plugins.name: void
plugins.description: Universal craftsman skills (TDD strict, TypeScript strict, hexagonal, DDD, functional, code-review, ...) plus hooks (tdd-guard, no-any, no-console-log, ...) and agents (senior-reviewer, security-reviewer, architect-critic).

plugins.name: void-monorepo
plugins.description: Turborepo + Bun monorepo conventions: shared tsconfig.strict.json, @repo/core (Result, Option, pipe), 5+5 service layout, ADR workflow.

plugins.name: void-react
plugins.description: React 19 conventions: component layer purity (no DB, no fetch), shadcn/Radix primitives, mobile-first dual-quality tokens, Tappable touch targets, accessibility-first defaults.

plugins.name: void-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js 16 App Router conventions: route groups, Cache Components defaults, instrumentation. Composes with void-react, void-server, void-pwa.

plugins.name: void-server
plugins.description: Server-side conventions: Server Actions trust boundary (defineAction, defineFormAction), withWebhookSafety, Zod ingress, rate limit, Drizzle migrations. Works across Next.js, Hono, standalone Bun/Node.

plugins.name: void-pwa
plugins.description: Progressive Web App conventions: manifest, service worker, offline-first patterns, install prompt UX, capture-queue + sync (Solaar-grade). Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: void-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile conventions: Expo + React Native, EAS Build, native module integration, safe-area, touch + gesture patterns. Composes with void-react.
